resolvedFindings.issue: Repository Firebase Project vs Runtime Firebase Project
resolvedFindings.expectedState: Repository Firebase default project matches the runtime production Firebase project.
resolvedFindings.actualStateBefore: .firebaserc default was torque-empire-crm-prod while runtime production evidence used torque-empire-ai-pro-crm.
resolvedFindings.rootCause: Repository Firebase CLI target had not been updated after production runtime configuration moved to torque-empire-ai-pro-crm.
resolvedFindings.risk: Rules, indexes, and function operations could be applied to the wrong Firebase project.
resolvedFindings.repairPerformed: .firebaserc default changed to torque-empire-ai-pro-crm; prior project retained as legacyProd for traceability.
resolvedFindings.deploymentRequired: No Vercel deployment required. Firebase CLI target alignment is a repository/release-operations change.
resolvedFindings.verificationEvidence: Post-repair Firebase index/database/function commands all targeted torque-empire-ai-pro-crm.

resolvedFindings.expectedState: Runtime Firestore composite indexes match firestore.indexes.json.
resolvedFindings.actualStateBefore: Runtime project returned zero composite indexes.
resolvedFindings.rootCause: Indexes had been deployed to the legacy/default Firebase project instead of the runtime project.
resolvedFindings.risk: Production Firestore queries could fail with missing-index errors under live traffic.
resolvedFindings.verificationEvidence: output/production-baseline/2026-06-28-reconciliation/firebase-firestore-indexes-live.json contains the five expected deals indexes.

resolvedFindings.expectedState: No failed production Cloud Functions remain.
resolvedFindings.actualStateBefore: Failed gcfv2 functions api and onUserCreate existed in us-central1.
resolvedFindings.rootCause: Stale functions from an older deployment remained in Firebase; current repository functions source exports only onContractorDocumentCreated.
resolvedFindings.risk: Failed stale functions created incident-response noise and could be mistaken for active production components.
resolvedFindings.repairPerformed: Deleted failed stale functions api and onUserCreate from torque-empire-ai-pro-crm.
resolvedFindings.deploymentRequired: Firebase functions delete completed; no app deployment required.

resolvedFindings.expectedState: Runtime Firestore database has delete protection enabled.
resolvedFindings.rootCause: Firestore database was created or maintained without delete protection.

resolvedFindings.expectedState: Authenticated production evidence exists for required roles and Vehicle Finance persistence workflow.
resolvedFindings.rootCause: Prior production validation did not complete and the QA seed did not include vehicleFinanceStaff.
resolvedFindings.risk: Production could not be release-certified for authenticated workflows.
resolvedFindings.repairPerformed: Added vehicleFinanceStaff to the QA seed, safely adopted same-email QA user documents, seeded production QA records, and ran authenticated production evidence.
resolvedFindings.deploymentRequired: No Vercel deployment required for evidence tooling. Production QA records were created with qa/safeToDelete metadata.
